input: Research home exchange programs for next vacation

gold.taskTitle: Research Home Exchange Programs for Next Vacation
gold.taskDescription: Research and evaluate home exchange programs to find the best option for an upcoming vacation.

questions.title: What is your intended vacation destination or region?
questions.description: Identify the specific country, region, or city the user wants to visit.

questions.title: When are you planning to take this vacation?
questions.description: Determine the target travel dates or timeframe for the trip.

questions.title: How many people will be staying in the exchanged home?
questions.description: Clarify the group size to understand space and bedroom requirements.

questions.title: Have you done a home exchange before?
questions.description: Establish the user's experience level with home exchange programs.

questions.title: Do you prefer a simultaneous or non-simultaneous home exchange?
questions.description: Find out whether the user wants to swap homes at the same time as their partner or use a points-based flexible system.

questions.title: What is your budget for membership fees or platform costs?
questions.description: Understand how much the user is willing to spend on joining and using a home exchange platform.

questions.title: What type of home do you have to offer for the exchange?
questions.description: Identify the user's property type, location, and any notable features that would affect their attractiveness as an exchange partner.
